item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day has a lot of structure, but none of it is about food. That's usually how meals get skipped, rushed, or grabbed on autopilot. Decide now what you'll eat at midday, and when. Eat it sitting down, without a screen. Notice hunger before you start and fullness before you finish. Food is fuel for the life you're building, so treat it as part of the plan. Action: put your midday meal on your calendar right now.
